from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document relevant to case categorization."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    administrative_subject: str = Field(description="The specific administrative body or entity involved in the case")
    case_type: str = Field(description="The case type or cause of action described in the document (e.g., Judicial Administration, Social Security)")
    administrative_category: str = Field(description="The broader administrative management category if explicitly stated in the text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
